answers: What did he say?
What did he tell you?
questions.hint: say = 말하다 (내용), tell = 누군가에게 말하다 (대상)
questions.explanation: say + 내용, tell + 사람 + 내용

answers: She told me a secret.
She shared a secret with me.
questions.hint: tell + 사람 + 내용
questions.explanation: say me a secret → 틀림. tell me a secret이 맞음

answers: We talked about the issue.
We discussed the problem.
questions.hint: talk about = discuss = 논의하다
questions.explanation: discuss 뒤엔 about 없이 바로 목적어 사용

answers: He speaks five languages.
He can speak five languages.
questions.hint: speak a language = 언어를 하다
questions.explanation: talk a language → 틀림. speak a language가 맞음

answers: She always speaks her mind.
She always tells it like it is.
questions.hint: speak one's mind = 솔직하게 말하다
questions.explanation: tell it like it is = 있는 그대로 말하다

answers: I made the decision.
The decision was mine.
questions.hint: make a decision / choice / plan / effort
questions.explanation: make = 창조, 결과를 만들어내는 행동에 사용

answers: I did a lot of work today.
I got a lot done today.
questions.hint: do + work / homework / favor / damage
questions.explanation: do = 행위 자체, get done = 완료 강조

answers: He finally got promoted.
He eventually received a promotion.
questions.hint: get + p.p. = 수동적으로 ~하게 되다
questions.explanation: get promoted = 승진하다

questions.korean: 커피 한 잔 할 수 있을까?
answers: Can I get a cup of coffee?
Could I have a coffee, please?
questions.hint: get = have = 달라고 요청할 때 사용
questions.explanation: Can I get = 미국식, Could I have = 격식체

questions.korean: 나는 그가 이해할 수 있게 설명했어.
answers: I made sure he understood.
I got him to understand.
questions.hint: make sure + 절 / get + 사람 + to + 동사원형
questions.explanation: get someone to do = 누군가가 ~하도록 하다

answers: Moreover, he has a lot of experience.
On top of that, he's very experienced.
questions.hint: moreover = furthermore = on top of that = 게다가

questions.korean: 다시 말하면, 우리에겐 계획 B가 필요해.
answers: In other words, we need a plan B.
That is to say, we need a backup plan.
questions.hint: in other words = that is to say = 다시 말하면

answers: Even so, it's worth trying.
That said, it's still worth a shot.
questions.hint: even so = that said = 그렇다 하더라도
questions.explanation: worth a shot = 시도해볼 가치가 있는

answers: In conclusion, the project was a success.
To sum up, the project went well.
questions.hint: in conclusion = to sum up = 결론적으로

questions.korean: 예를 들어, 사과나 바나나 같은 과일이야.
answers: For example, fruits like apples or bananas.
For instance, apples and bananas are good examples.
questions.hint: for example = for instance = 예를 들어

answers: I feel uneasy about the decision.
I have mixed feelings about it.
questions.hint: feel uneasy / have mixed feelings = 찜찜하다, 불안하다
questions.explanation: mixed feelings = 복잡한 감정

questions.korean: 그는 칭찬을 들었을 때 어쩔 줄을 몰랐어.
answers: He didn't know how to react when he was complimented.
He was at a loss for words when he received the compliment.
questions.hint: be at a loss for words = 할 말을 잃다

questions.korean: 그 프레젠테이션에 대해 긴장이 됐지만, 결국 잘 됐어.
answers: I was nervous about the presentation, but it turned out well.
I had butterflies about it, but it went smoothly.
questions.hint: have butterflies = 긴장하다 (관용어)
questions.explanation: turn out well / go smoothly = 잘 되다

answers: He is enthusiastic about the proposal.
He's really excited about the idea.
questions.hint: enthusiastic about = excited about = 열정적인

answers: I just let it go.
I brushed it off.
questions.hint: let it go / brush it off = 무시하다, 넘기다
questions.explanation: brush off = 가볍게 무시하다

questions.korean: 내 관점에서 보면, 그건 공정하지 않아.
answers: From my perspective, that's not fair.
As I see it, it's not right.
questions.hint: from my perspective = as I see it = 내 관점에서

answers: I strongly believe that it's the right thing to do.
I'm firmly convinced that it's correct.
questions.hint: strongly believe / firmly convinced = 굳게 믿다

questions.korean: 내 말은, 우리가 더 열심히 해야 한다는 거야.
answers: What I mean is, we need to work harder.
My point is that we should put in more effort.
questions.hint: What I mean is / My point is = 내 말은

questions.korean: 그 점을 고려해볼 때, 좀 더 조심해야 해.
answers: Given that point, we should be more careful.
Considering that, we need to proceed with caution.
questions.hint: given that / considering that = ~을 고려해볼 때

answers: The fact of the matter is, it's not possible.
Frankly, it just can't be done.
questions.hint: The fact of the matter is = 사실은, 실제로는

answers: I want to take back my decision.
I wish I could undo that decision.
questions.hint: take back = 취소하다, 되돌리다
questions.explanation: undo = 되돌리다

answers: Things are getting out of hand.
The situation is spiraling out of control.
questions.hint: get out of hand = 통제를 벗어나다
questions.explanation: spiral out of control = 걷잡을 수 없이 나빠지다

answers: He got himself into a tough spot.
He ended up in a difficult situation.
questions.hint: get into a tough spot = 어려운 상황에 처하다
questions.explanation: end up in = 결국 ~에 처하다

answers: I put the plan into action.
I carried out the plan.
questions.hint: put into action / carry out = 실행하다

answers: They worked out the problem together.
They sorted out the issue between them.
questions.hint: work out / sort out = 해결하다

answers: It's been a rough day.
What a day it has been.
questions.hint: rough = tough = hard = 힘든
questions.explanation: It's been a rough/tough day = 원어민이 자주 쓰는 표현

answers: I hope it works out.
I'm rooting for you.
questions.hint: work out = 잘 되다, root for = 응원하다
questions.explanation: rooting for you = 너를 응원해

answers: That makes sense.
That adds up.
questions.hint: make sense / add up = 말이 되다, 이해가 되다

answers: I just wanted to check in.
I was just touching base.
questions.hint: check in / touch base = 안부를 묻다, 확인하다
questions.explanation: touch base = 가볍게 확인하다 (비즈니스 표현)

answers: I found it annoying.
It got on my nerves.
questions.hint: get on one's nerves = 신경을 건드리다, 짜증나게 하다

answers: I have few friends.
I don't have many friends.
questions.hint: few (가산) = 거의 없는 (부정적)
questions.explanation: few = 거의 없다, a few = 몇 개 있다 (차이 중요)

answers: I have a few friends.
I have some friends.
questions.hint: a few (가산) = 몇 명 있음 (긍정적)

answers: I have little time.
I barely have any time.
questions.hint: little (불가산) = 거의 없는
questions.explanation: little = 거의 없다, a little = 조금 있다

answers: There is a little water.
There's some water left.
questions.hint: a little (불가산) = 조금 있음 (긍정적)

questions.korean: 많은 사람들이 그 문제를 알고 있어.
answers: Quite a few people know about the issue.
A good number of people are aware of the problem.
questions.hint: quite a few = 꽤 많은
questions.explanation: quite a few = 상당히 많은 수

answers: I have known him for ten years.
I've known him for a decade.
questions.hint: know는 진행형 불가 → 현재완료 사용
questions.explanation: know, love, believe 등 상태동사는 진행형 사용 안 함

answers: My passport has expired.
My passport is expired.
questions.hint: has expired = 만료됐다 (현재완료), is expired = 만료 상태
questions.explanation: 둘 다 쓰지만 has expired가 더 자연스러움

questions.korean: 나는 그가 올지 안 올지 모르겠어.
answers: I don't know if he is coming.
I'm not sure whether he'll show up.
questions.hint: if = whether (간접 의문)

answers: The meeting lasted three hours.
The meeting went on for three hours.
questions.hint: last = go on for = ~동안 계속되다
questions.explanation: take three hours = 3시간이 걸리다 (소요 시간)

answers: He is learning English.
He is studying English.
questions.hint: learn = 배우다 (결과 포함), study = 공부하다 (과정)
questions.explanation: learn English = 배워가는 중, study English = 공부 중

questions.korean: 네가 뭐라고 말하든, 나는 내 마음을 바꾸지 않을 거야.
answers: No matter what you say, I won't change my mind.
Whatever you say, I'm not going to change my mind.
questions.hint: No matter what / Whatever = 뭐라 해도

answers: He went to work despite feeling sick.
Even though he was sick, he showed up to work.
questions.hint: despite + ~ing / even though + 절

questions.korean: 내가 그를 더 잘 알았더라면, 그냥 그러려니 했을 텐데.
answers: Had I known him better, I would have just let it go.
If I had known him better, I wouldn't have taken it personally.
questions.hint: Had I + p.p. = If I had + p.p. (도치 가정법)
questions.explanation: Had I = 가정법 도치

questions.korean: 그것이 되든 안 되든, 우리는 계속 시도할 거야.
answers: Whether it works or not, we'll keep trying.
Regardless of the outcome, we're going to keep going.
questions.hint: Whether A or B = A이든 B이든
questions.explanation: regardless of = ~와 상관없이

questions.korean: 지금 와서 돌이켜보면, 그 결정이 옳았어.
answers: Looking back on it now, that was the right decision.
In hindsight, it was the right call.
questions.hint: looking back on = in hindsight = 돌이켜보면
questions.explanation: in hindsight = 지나고 보니
